full_judgment:
2. The petitioner was a monthly tenant under landlord respondent in respect of three portion of the disputed premises under lease agreement dated 1.11.72, 1.11.74 and 1.1.75 respectively. The petitioner paid rent for the month of April 1991 in the first week of May but the landlord signed the rent receipt putting the date thereon 5.6.91. Thereafter the tenant paid the rent for the month of May 1991 but the landlord did not give any rent receipt. When the tenant went to pay the rent for the month of June 1991 the landlord demanded higher rent. Thereafter the tenant filed House Rent Case No. 21, 24 and 26 of 1991 in the Court of House Rent Controller. He also filed House Rent Control Case Nos. 22, 25 and 27/91. The landlord contested 

 the cases by filing written statement stating that the cases are barred under section 18(5) of the Ordinance. He also denied payment of rent for the month of May 1991 and asserted that the tenant was a defaulter upon whom the notice under section 106 of the Transfer of Property Act, 1882 was served. 

 3. The trial court heard the aforesaid cases simultaneously and dismissed the same leading to filing of Miscellaneous Appeal Nos. 78, 79 and 80 of 1991 in the lower appellate court which the lower appellate court dismissed the same leading to filing the revisional applications under section 115 C. P. C.
